content.stem: 负责监督银行交易监控方法的治理和有效性的团队应实施哪些策略？(选择两项.)

options.A: 定期审查向金融犯罪执法网络(FinCEN)提交的可疑活动报告(SAR)，以确定是否应撤回其中任何一份
options.B: 定期及临时与法律团队合作，对传票对象或政府调查所涉交易进行适当调查和监控
options.C: 定期审查客户档案，以确保高风险客户的档案信息是最新的，并符合银行内部政策和程序
options.D: 定期审查交易监测场景及其成效，以确保适当反映反洗钱的各类模式

content.stem_en: A team overseeing the governance and effectiveness of a bank's transaction monitoring approach should implement which strategies? (Select Two.)

options_en.A: Periodic review of suspicious activity reports (SARs) filed with FinCEN to determine whether any should be withdrawn
options_en.B: Periodic and ad hoc cooperation with the legal team to appropriately investigate and monitor the transactions of subjects of subpoenas or government inquiries
options_en.C: Periodic review of client profiles to ensure that the most up-to-date information is on file for high-risk clients in line with the bank's internal policies and procedures
options_en.D: Periodic review of transaction monitoring scenarios and their effectiveness to ensure that appropriate AML typologies are reflected
